terms.title: Terms
body: wtx is provided as-is to help you plan and log your training. Use your own judgment about what is safe for your body.
An account is optional. If you create one, you are responsible for keeping your password safe and for what you share in group workouts.
Don't use group workouts to harass other people. We may remove accounts that abuse the service.
You can stop using wtx and delete your account at any time from Configuration.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: Without an account, everything stays on your device.
With an account we store your email, your display name, your routines and your workout sessions so they sync across devices.
In a group workout, the other members see your display name and the sets you complete in that room.
Data is stored with our database provider (Supabase). We don't sell it or use it for advertising.
Deleting your account from Configuration permanently removes all of this data.
